narrative.intro: Frequentis Usa obligated $298M in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa has 9 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $33.1M, and obligations are up 90.8% year over year. Obligations rose sharply from prior years: FY25 totaled $156M, FY24 totaled $34.3M, FY23 totaled $7.2M, FY22 totaled $7.6M, and FY21 totaled $8.4M. Market activity is concentrated in a single industry. Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing accounts for $283M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Frequentis Usa also has recorded obligations in Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing ($9.6M), Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($3.9M), Engineering Services ($662K), Computer Systems Design Services ($100K), and Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance ($55.2K). The totals above are contract obligations for the current fiscal year to date, while award-value figures in detailed award and expiring-contracts tables would reflect total contract values when present.
